limitations: Experimental MKII, Bank A, home A01 and compatible sixteen-step pattern grids. Rows are volatile.
Needs the contributor development base 5c32cbacd and ABI 9 sequencer/panel capability; public integration is pending.
TRACK input is owned inside the overlay. Track Solo and Play Modes coexistence on this revision is unqualified.
Early modal edit interlock limits stock sound pages with foreign sources.

highlights: Quantized row advance through defined slots
usage: ARR opens Row. ARR again opens Clip.
